Title: Container build hygiene (.dockerignore)
Description (Notes): Stop the host-built .venv/caches/secrets being copied into the runtime image (overrides builder venv, causes HTTP 424).
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): dockerignore excludes .venv/__pycache__/*.pyc/.env*/.git • image contains only builder-stage venv • deployed runtime passes /ping

Title: Region-safe model IDs
Description (Notes): Replace us.* inference profiles with region-valid global.*/au.* IDs in agentcore.json, config.py, and .env.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): no us.* IDs remain • Processor and Validator invoke in target region • model IDs documented per region

Title: Gateway tool-name namespacing map
Description (Notes): Resolve Phase-3 bare tool names to the Gateway's <target>___<tool> names.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): all Phase-3 tool calls succeed • map validated against live Gateway tool list • no Unknown tool errors

Title: Autonomous-operation prompt
Description (Notes): Remove wait-for-approval so the Processor decides autonomously instead of asking for input.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): prompt forbids clarification/approval waits • Processor decides on a complete claim with no human input

Title: Forced structured-output decision fallback
Description (Notes): Force a validated decision via structured_output_async when submit_decision is skipped.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): forced decision produced when tool skipped • same field shape downstream • repeated happy-path runs reach ACCEPT

Title: Region resolution hardening
Description (Notes): Fall back to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION then boto3 session region instead of hardcoded us-west-2.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): local dev with only a profile resolves correct region • Memory/Gateway target deploy region w/o extra exports

Title: Memory identifier sanitization
Description (Notes): Sanitize external identifiers (emails) before use as Memory actorId/sessionId.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): inputs map to IDs matching actorId & sessionId regexes • ListEvents/writes succeed with email actor • safe fallback for invalid input

Title: Structured tool-result logging
Description (Notes): Replace noisy {'raw':...} blobs with clean structured one-line logs.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): successful claim logs readable one-liner (id/status/amount) • errors log clearly with trace id

Title: Baseline regression test suite
Description (Notes): Lock the Phase-0 fixes with automated tests.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): tests cover venv-exclusion, model IDs, tool-name resolution, forced decision, region fallback, id sanitization • runs in CI and fails on regression

Title: Core-vs-domain boundary map
Description (Notes): Document which components are reusable engine vs domain-specific per client.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): every file/resource classified core or domain • reviewed and signed off

Title: Client configuration spec
Description (Notes): Design the single declarative source of truth driving a client deployment.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): documented schema with examples • covers every domain surface from E1.1 • peer-reviewed with a sample config

Title: Extension-point interfaces
Description (Notes): Define interfaces for Agent, Tool, TriggerAdapter, DataAdapter, PolicySet.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): interfaces defined with types/docstrings • one reference impl validates against each

Title: Architecture decision records
Description (Notes): Capture config format, orchestration model, and tenancy decisions as ADRs.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): ADRs for config format, orchestration, isolation exist and approved

Title: Config schema + validator
Description (Notes): Machine-readable schema + validator that fails fast on invalid config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): invalid configs rejected with actionable errors • valid sample passes • validation in CI and pre-deploy

Title: Externalize agent definitions
Description (Notes): Move prompts/model/tool bindings from main.py into config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): each agent loads prompt/model/tools from config • no agent literals in main.py • claims behavior unchanged with claims config

Title: Config-driven structured-output schemas
Description (Notes): Make decision/validation output schemas configurable per client.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): output schema fields in config • runtime validates output against configured schema

Title: Config-driven routing rules
Description (Notes): Externalize thresholds and decision->action matrix.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): thresholds/matrix read from config • routing changes need no code • covered by tests

Title: Parameterize naming/branding
Description (Notes): Derive all resource names/labels from config; remove hardcoded ClaimsAgent.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): no hardcoded product/domain names • two configs yield non-colliding names

Title: Data-model abstraction
Description (Notes): Generalize DynamoDB entities and seeds from config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): entities/keys/seeds in config • CDK provisions tables from config • seeds load

Title: Pluggable memory namespaces & actor-id
Description (Notes): Make memory namespaces and actor-id strategy configurable.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): namespaces/actor-id from config • sanitization applied • per-actor isolation verified

Title: Cedar policy templating
Description (Notes): Generate Cedar policies from config instead of hardcoded $100k rule.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): policies rendered from config • policy-block behavior verified by test

Title: Optional Guardrails integration
Description (Notes): Add opt-in Bedrock Guardrails wired via config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): toggle in config • applied when enabled, no-op when off • documented

Title: Configurable orchestration
Description (Notes): Support single/dual/multi-agent pipelines defined in config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): pipeline shape driven by config • single-agent and dual-agent configs both run

Title: Pluggable execution phase
Description (Notes): Make post-decision execution wiring configurable.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): execution actions declared in config and dispatched generically • claims execution reproduced via config

Title: Trigger adapter interface + generic trigger
Description (Notes): Abstract ingress behind a TriggerAdapter interface + generic trigger Lambda.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): interface defined; email/S3 reimplemented as adapter • existing invocation behavior unchanged

Title: Additional trigger adapters (API/schedule/queue)
Description (Notes): Implement REST/API, schedule (EventBridge), and queue (SQS) adapters.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): each adapter deployable via config and invokes runtime • one integration test per adapter

Title: Pluggable tool registry
Description (Notes): Drive Gateway targets/tool wiring from a config registry.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): adding/removing a tool is config-only • targets generated from registry • names resolve at call time

Title: Reusable standard-tool library
Description (Notes): Provide opt-in building-block tools (notify, data CRUD, human review).
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): >=3 reusable tools packaged and documented • a client enables one via config with no code

Title: create-client scaffolding CLI
Description (Notes): Generator producing a new deployable client project from template + config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): one command scaffolds a runnable project • generated project deploys without manual edits

Title: Config -> agentcore.json / CDK generator
Description (Notes): Generate agentcore.json and CDK params from config; kill manual placeholder edits.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): no PLACEHOLDER values after generation • generated agentcore.json passes agentcore validate

Title: Per-client identity provisioning
Description (Notes): Automate Cognito pool/app-client/Identity credential provisioning per client.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): Cognito + Identity provisioned from config • no secrets in source-controlled files

Title: Per-client deploy pipeline
Description (Notes): Idempotent, repeatable deploy into isolated account/stack with tagging.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): re-running deploy is idempotent • resources tagged with client id • teardown verified

Title: CI pipeline
Description (Notes): Lint, unit tests, container build, dependency/secret scanning on every change.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): CI runs on PRs and blocks on failure • secret scan catches committed credentials

Title: Automated eval gates
Description (Notes): Run AgentCore Evaluations as a gate; block low-quality deploys.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): eval suite runs pre-deploy • below-threshold results fail the pipeline

Title: Generalized integration/e2e harness
Description (Notes): Parameterize test scripts by client config for e2e verification.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): one harness runs e2e against any config • happy-path, policy-block, human-review pass

Title: Secrets hygiene
Description (Notes): Remove secrets from .env/agentcore.json; use Identity vault / Secrets Manager.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): no plaintext secrets in repo or generated files • runtime retrieves secrets at runtime

Title: Least-privilege IAM + isolation/audit
Description (Notes): Templated least-privilege roles; per-client isolation, CloudTrail, tagging, cost attribution.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): IAM scoped to required actions/resources • cost/audit reports attributable per client

Title: Standard observability
Description (Notes): Bake dashboards and alarms into every deployment.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): each deploy provisions standard dashboards/alarms • key failure modes alarm

Title: Runbooks
Description (Notes): Runbooks for deploy, teardown, credential rotation, incident response.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): runbooks exist and validated by a dry run

Title: Framework documentation
Description (Notes): Architecture docs, config-spec reference, extension guides.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): config-spec reference documents every field • add-a-tool/agent/trigger guides exist

Title: Onboarding playbook + intake questionnaire
Description (Notes): Repeatable client-intake process mapping needs to a config.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): questionnaire->config mapping documented • one dry-run onboarding completed

Title: Second-domain validation build
Description (Notes): Build a different domain end-to-end using only config (Definition of Done).
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): new domain deploys config-only with zero core edits • passes the e2e harness

Title: Estimation & engagement template
Description (Notes): Sizing model and engagement template for new clients.
Acceptance Criteria (checklist): template estimates effort from a filled questionnaire • reviewed with delivery leadership
